notes: State Cliopatria lacks (no row). Dholpur and Karauli, two of the four members, have no dossier (they are not in Cliopatria or polities.csv) and need one; their lands are circles of the infobox areas centred on the towns (approximate coordinates, not in the gazetteer). The capital is unverified: none of the five pages opened names it. The successor Greater Rajasthan (United State of Rajasthan, 15 May 1949 to 1956, then Rajasthan) has no dossier either. The pages disagree on the dates of the members' accession: the Matsya Union and Alwar pages give the union as 18 March 1948; the Dholpur State page has Udai Bhan Singh's instrument of accession on 7 April 1949; the Karauli State page has accession on 4 August 1947 'to form Matsya Union'. The dossier keeps 18 March 1948 for all four and the 1949 date as a note. All of the land is inside the Dominion of India (republic-of-india, Cliopatria 'Republic of India' from 1947), which draws the whole subcontinent's Indian part in one shape: the renderer should let the union take precedence over India's shape for these years or the map will double-draw it. No wars.
